caption: A snorkel mask is lowered under the water, and the blurred rocks below come into sharp view through the mask.

sa.check: A snorkel mask is lowered under the water.
Blurred rocks below come into sharp view through the mask.
The rocks are blurred before the mask is lowered.
The mask goes under first and the sharp view follows.

pc.expect: The rocks are clear through the mask and blurred outside it.
pc.fail: They are blurred through the mask; or sharp outside it; or the mask shows a different scene.

pc.expect: The rocks are unchanged; they look nearer and larger through the mask.
pc.fail: They look smaller; or they move; or a different bottom appears.

pc.expect: The mask moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It floats away; or dives by itself; or jumps.

pc.expect: The mask's glass is rigid and the water liquid.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the water is rigid; or the mask fills and stays clear.
The mask duplicates; or the rocks vanish; or the hand passes through the mask.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mask and the water's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The mask changes colour; or the water changes; or the rocks change colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
